title: 第九章 白猿六变第十章 练拳
slug: 从白猿拳破限开始成就人间武圣
content_zh:
翌日清晨，薄雾冥冥。
为了保险起见，苏羽跟着大哥苏鸿一同进了城。
两人交了入城费，穿过繁华的主干道，拐入外城西侧一片相对安静的街区。这里巷弄深幽，青石板路蜿蜒曲折。
最终，苏鸿在一座略显陈旧的青瓦大院前停下脚步。
门楣上悬着一块黑匾，上书白猿武馆四个大字，笔力苍劲，但是牌匾略显陈旧，有些斑驳。
“二弟，这就是白猿武馆。秦馆主虽然脾气怪，但本事是真材实料的。”苏鸿拍了拍苏羽的肩膀，“想好了就进去吧。”
“嗯。大哥你去帮里吧，小心点。”
目送苏鸿离开，苏羽深吸一口气，整理了一下衣衫。
长春武馆那种养生拳法非他所求。这乱世之中，唯有杀伐手段才能护身！
“咚！咚！咚！”
他上前扣响了门扉上的铜环。
片刻后，厚重的木门“吱呀”一声开了条缝。
一个赤膊壮汉探出头来：“何事？”
苏羽恭敬抱拳一礼，“在下苏羽，慕名而来，想拜师学武！”
壮汉上下打量了他一眼，侧身让开：“进来吧。”
进入院门，穿过影壁，豁然开朗。
前院中，几十名弟子正赤着上身练拳。喝哈之声震天，虽是深秋，那一股股蓬勃的气血波动，热气蒸腾，让苏羽暗暗心惊。
穿过前院，苏羽被领进一处幽静的后院。
一棵老槐树下，躺椅上正躺着一位须发皆白的老者，闭目养神，旁边放着一壶凉茶。
“秦师，有人拜师。”壮汉恭敬通报。

这老者便是秦方琼，数十年前来到黑石城，凭借一手凶悍的白猿拳在这打出名堂，创立白猿武馆。如今虽已年迈，余威犹在。
秦方琼缓缓睁开眼，眼神浑浊中透着精光，如同一头打盹的老猿醒来。
他的目光盯在苏羽身上，给人一种莫名的压力。
这种压力让苏羽只觉得浑身不自在，想要闪躲。仿佛被一只猛兽盯上，下一秒就要把他撕碎。
若是胆小之人，怕是当场就要露怯。
苏羽却强忍着那股如芒在背的不适，脊背挺得笔直，直视老者的目光，再次抱拳：“晚辈苏羽，清溪村人，特来拜师！”
秦方琼见到苏羽表现，微微点头。
这小子看着瘦弱，但这股胆气和心性倒是可以。练武之人，若是没了胆气，那便是一滩烂泥，扶不上墙。
这种人，他不收！
除非……得加钱！
“年龄如何？”
“十八。”
“这岁数才来学武，晚了点。”秦方琼摇了摇头，从躺椅上起身，围着苏羽转了一圈，突然探出一只细长枯瘦的手，闪电般捏住了苏羽的肩膀。
content_en:
The next morning, there was a mist.
To be on the safe side, Su Yu followed his elder brother Su Hong into the city.
The two paid the city entrance fee, crossed the bustling main road, and turned into a relatively quiet neighborhood on the west side of the outer city. The alleys here are deep and quiet, and the bluestone roads are winding.
Finally, Su Hong stopped in front of a slightly old blue-tiled courtyard.
There is a black plaque hanging on the lintel, with the four characters "White Ape Martial Arts School" written in vigorous writing, but the plaque is a bit old and mottled.
"Second brother, this is the White Ape Martial Arts School. Although Master Qin has a weird temper, his skills are real." Su Hong patted Su Yu on the shoulder, "Go in if you think about it."
"Yeah. Brother, go to the gang and be careful."
After watching Su Hong leave, Su Yu took a deep breath and straightened his clothes.
The kind of health-preserving boxing method from Changchun Martial Arts School was not what he wanted. In this troubled world, the only way to protect yourself is through killing!
"Boom! Boom! Boom!"
He stepped forward and clicked the brass ring on the door.
After a moment, the heavy wooden door creaked open.
A shirtless strong man stuck his head out: "What's the matter?"
Su Yu respectfully cupped his fists and saluted, "My Su Yu, I came here because of my reputation and want to learn martial arts from my master!"
The strong man looked him up and down, then stepped aside: "Come in."
Entering the courtyard gate, passing through the screen wall, you suddenly become enlightened.
In the front yard, dozens of disciples were practicing boxing with their upper bodies bare. The sound of drinking was loud. Even though it was late autumn, the vigorous fluctuations of Qi and blood and the steaming steam made Su Yu secretly frightened.
After passing through the front yard, Su Yu was led into a quiet backyard.
Under an old locust tree, an old man with white hair and beard was lying on a recliner. He closed his eyes and meditated. There was a pot of herbal tea next to him.
"Master Qin, someone wants to be my disciple." The strong man informed respectfully.
This old man is Qin Fangqiong. He came to Black Rock City decades ago, made a name for himself here with his fierce White Ape Fist, and founded the White Ape Martial Arts School. Although he is old now, his power is still there.
Qin Fangqiong slowly opened his eyes, his eyes were cloudy and gleaming, like an old ape waking up from a nap.
His eyes were fixed on Su Yu, giving people an inexplicable pressure.
This kind of pressure made Su Yu feel uncomfortable all over and wanted to dodge. It was as if he was being targeted by a ferocious beast that would tear him apart in the next second.
If you are a timid person, you may show your timidity on the spot.
However, Su Yu endured the discomfort that was like a ray of light on his back, straightened his back, looked directly into the old man's eyes, and clasped his fists again: "Junior Su Yu, a native of Qingxi Village, came here to be my disciple!"
Seeing Su Yu's performance, Qin Fangqiong nodded slightly.
This kid looks thin, but his courage and character are quite good. If a person who practices martial arts loses his courage, he will be like a puddle of mud, unable to hold himself up against the wall.
He won’t accept this kind of person!
Unless...you have to pay more!
"How is your age?"
"Eighteen."
"It's too late to learn martial arts at this age." Qin Fangqiong shook his head, stood up from the recliner, walked around Su Yu, and suddenly stretched out a slender hand and pinched Su Yu's shoulder like lightning.
